title: Compare burst recovery with baseline SCHC
description:
Run trace-driven offline comparisons of the approved experiment against validated baseline SCHC ACK-on-Error and explicitly specified ARQ alternatives. Hold encoded input, source load, topology, receiver resources and airtime constraints constant. Include independent links, shared receivers, correlated interference and header/control/ACK loss.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Offline execution only within microfrag.06 approval. Use admission.14 and ci.15 evidence for the baseline rather than a duplicate toy ledger. No RF, operating-authority conclusion or baseline protocol replacement follows from a favorable model result.
acceptance_criteria: Independent event/loss traces and the frozen comparison criteria produce complete delivery, loss, latency, goodput, scheduled time and emitted/per-frequency airtime reports. Failed and zero-delivery runs stay failures with appropriate latency treatment. No binomial independent-collision model is reported as measured network capacity.
